NEGROS POWER ADVISORY
MANUAL LOAD DROPPING (MLD) SCHEDULE
Update as of 1:32 PM | September 8, 2026 (Tuesday)
Due to the alert levels declared by the National Grid Corporation of the Philippines (NGCP) today, Distribution Utilities (DUs) in the Visayas, including Negros Power, have been directed to implement possible power interruptions through Manual Load Dropping (MLD). 
As per NGCP, in their advisory today via https://www.facebook.com/share/p/1DEjgDwuEi/ , 7 plants are on forced outage on September, 4 plants since August 2026, 1 plant since July, 2 plants since June, 7 plants since May, 3 plants since 2025, 2 plants since 2024, 2 plants since 2023, and 1 plant since 2021, while 14 plants are running on derated capacities, for a total of 786.4MW unavailable to the grid.
Factor/s that contributed to the RED and YELLOW Alert declarations:
1. Unavailability of Visayas' large coal plants TVI 1 and PEDC 3
2. Limited power import from Mindanao grid 
At present, the following feeders are being considered for possible MLD implementation (refer to the photo provided). In the meantime, the following are the actual areas that are currently offline:
